positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Designed and implemented several features within the Reporting as a Service BE team, including:
* a data ingestion pipeline with a throughput of millions of reporting results per day
* a debug endpoint to expose internal API calls to frontend services
* Used Java, Kafka, S3/Athena, SQL

positions.title: Head Teaching Assistant for 15-150 Principles of Functional Programming
positions.description:
* Strove to maintain accommodating, fair, and efficient course policies in an effort to successfully manage a challenging CS course of 300+ students and ~40 TAs
* Co-led teams in charge of developing and maintaining lab and homework materials
* Streamlined and managed course procedures, including grading, playtesting, content teams, and staff meetings
* Improved LaTeX/Python templates by adding manual code deduction and rubric notes support

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
* Furthered the transition of a Java-based Tutor Authoring Tool to a web-based Javascript app.
* Used Vue, JavaScript, HTML/CSS

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for 15-150 Principles of Functional Programming
positions.description:
* Prepared teaching material for and led recitations, held office hours, reworked homeworks and wrote student reference material.
* Designed and developed a data type visualization tool in HTML/CSS and JavaScript to help students with SML testing of trees.
* Developed a parody web app of the 15-150 Office Hours site for student enjoyment :)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Member of the Display Configuration Team
* Designed and developed a .NET WinForms tool from the ground up that streamlined the XML configuration process (C#, NUnit UT)
* Worked within an agile workflow to deliver iterative configuration updates to machine displays (XML, C++, Cucumber AT)
* Became accustomed to a wide variety of tools and practices, ranging from a Model View Controller pattern to Git submodules
* Aided in the subsequent onboarding of new entry-level team members

positions.title: Volunteer Research Assistant
positions.description:
* Engaged in front-end development for a mobile and large-display game focusing on collaborative mental health education
* Designed and developed features of the game, including mini-games and overall UI (Unity, C#, Microsoft Azure PlayFab)

organizations.description: Organized and led two projects across two years: 1) a campus React workshop to display animated designs onto the university’s iconic bridge, and 2) a chrome extension that spotlights a local minority-owned Pittsburgh business on new tabs in the browser.
